The flowers must match the attached product reference photos exactly: same flower shape, petal layers, color and color edges, leaf shape and texture, bud shape. Keep real scale: Ranunculus stems are about 52 cm long; flower head diameter is not specified in reference.

Light Peach ranunculus in a cream stoneware jug on a small walnut side table next to an oat linen armchair, one open book on the table, 50mm at seated eye level.

Product references control flowers and quantity. Style references control lighting, palette and materials only. Every ranunculus stem has two open flowers and one bud, with the silver-green flocked leaves shown in the product source; the peony filename is a legacy label, not a peony flower type.
